I tried multiple products to counter the effects, but most barely helped—and some were expensive. I eventually started to assume it was just aging and menopause catching up with me. Then one day at the salon, my stylist commented on the condition of my hair. When I explained what had been happening, she had me talk to her receptionist, who had gone through the exact same thing. She told me she had tried several filters before finally finding one that actually worked: The Buudy Filter. Her hair was long, shiny, and gorgeous, so I paid attention. After doing my own research on Buudy and their products, I ordered the system immediately. I felt the difference the very first time I used it, and within a few weeks I could see the improvement. I was thrilled. I’ve been telling all my friends—those on well water and even those on city water—because the change has been that dramatic. Even if I move, I’ll continue using Buudy filters. They’ve made a real difference for me.

I've been to so many doctors trying to figure out what was happening through repeated bloodwork, hormone tests, dermatologist appointments and everything came back normal but my appearance was anything but normal for me so I started researching and trying to figure it out on my own when it dawned on me that when I was at a fancy spa/ hotel for a weekend, my hair and skin looked great. I can't believe the difference!! I just hope this continues bc I want my skin and hair the way out was prior to the move!! title: Truly life changing - Worth every penny

I was told several things by doctors and "hair experts" ranging from: poor diet, iron deficiency, and genes. I did almost EVERYTHING under the sun (except hair transplant surgery) I was heading in that direction. I was so depressed and my self esteem suffered greatly. When the advertisement for Buudy came on my YouTube, I was so hesitant because I had already been through so much with little to insignificant results. But after like 30 minutes of thought, I decided another hundred + bucks wouldn't break the bank and the worst case scenario I'd return it if it didn't do anything. I didn't really have expectations. The very first day I used it I didn't notice much except my skin didn't feel as dry. The second day I noticed I just felt cleaner. Day after day I started to notice my skin wasn't drying out anymore. I noticed less hair fall out but still didn't get my hopes up. Come forward about 3 weeks in and my hair shedding has reduced by about 80% if not more. INCREDIBLE! I almost cried of happiness yesterday when I showed my husband my hairbrush without tons of hair on it. I brushed it for 10 minutes and only 3-5 strands were on it. My hair is soooo shiny now and soft. Before. Regularly daily there were dozens and at the end of day 100+. I was slowly balding. I'm not anymore. It wasn't my genes, or my diet, or anything I was doing wrong. It was dirty polluted water!!!! Thanks for taking the time to read my long review. I hope this information helps someone. Thanks Buudy! I'm truly grateful.
